title: Ceph storage
description: Ceph capacity, pools and their growth, and who uses the space: raw bytes per consumer, app and volume, snapshots and residuals. The first two rows come from the Ceph mgr and need no exporter; the rest is measured by the storage-usage exporter (kube-cluster/apps/storage-usage).

list.name: cluster
list.label: Cluster
list.description: Applies to the Ceph mgr rows only.

panels.title: Raw capacity used by device class
panels.description: Used share of the raw capacity per OSD device class, and the fullest OSD of each class. Orange from the nearfull ratio, red from the full ratio; the thresholds are set by hand to the ratios shown on the right. One query sorted by class, so the bars keep their order. Source: ceph_osd_stat_bytes(_used) by ceph_osd_metadata.device_class.

targets.expr: sort_by_label(label_set(sum by (device_class) (max by (ceph_daemon) (ceph_osd_stat_bytes_used) * on (ceph_daemon) group_left (device_class) max by (ceph_daemon, device_class) (ceph_osd_metadata)) / sum by (device_class) (max by (ceph_daemon) (ceph_osd_stat_bytes) * on (ceph_daemon) group_left (device_class) max by (ceph_daemon, device_class) (ceph_osd_metadata)), "order", "1", "what", "used") or label_replace(label_set(topk by (device_class) (1, max by (ceph_daemon) (ceph_osd_stat_bytes_used) / max by (ceph_daemon) (ceph_osd_stat_bytes) * on (ceph_daemon) group_left (device_class) max by (ceph_daemon, device_class) (ceph_osd_metadata)), "order", "2"), "what", "fullest ($1)", "ceph_daemon", "(.*)"), "device_class", "order")

panels.title: Raw capacity by device class
panels.description: OSD raw bytes summed per device class (ceph_osd_metadata.device_class). Source: ceph_osd_stat_bytes(_used).

targets.expr: sum by (device_class) (max by (ceph_daemon) (ceph_osd_stat_bytes_used) * on (ceph_daemon) group_left (device_class) max by (ceph_daemon, device_class) (ceph_osd_metadata))
sum by (device_class) (max by (ceph_daemon) (ceph_osd_stat_bytes) * on (ceph_daemon) group_left (device_class) max by (ceph_daemon, device_class) (ceph_osd_metadata))

sum by (device_class) (max by (ceph_daemon) (ceph_osd_stat_bytes) * on (ceph_daemon) group_left (device_class) max by (ceph_daemon, device_class) (ceph_osd_metadata)) - sum by (device_class) (max by (ceph_daemon) (ceph_osd_stat_bytes_used) * on (ceph_daemon) group_left (device_class) max by (ceph_daemon, device_class) (ceph_osd_metadata))

panels.title: Nearfull ratio
panels.description: Ratio at which Ceph warns of a nearly full OSD. Source: ceph_osd_nearfull_ratio.

targets.expr: max(ceph_osd_nearfull_ratio{cluster=~"$cluster|"})

panels.title: Full ratio
panels.description: Ratio at which Ceph stops writes to an OSD. Source: ceph_osd_full_ratio.

targets.expr: max(ceph_osd_full_ratio{cluster=~"$cluster|"})

panels.title: Pools
panels.description: Factor is raw divided by stored. Stored is the data written by clients, raw what it occupies on disk (replication or erasure coding, before compression savings). Growth is the 7-day trend of stored. Time to full is max avail divided by that growth, only for growing pools that fill within 10 years; max avail is shared by pools on the same OSDs, so the times are not additive. Source: ceph_pool_* metrics of the mgr.

targets.expr: max by (pool_id, name) (ceph_pool_metadata{cluster=~"$cluster|"})
max by (pool_id) (ceph_pool_stored{cluster=~"$cluster|"})
max by (pool_id) (ceph_pool_bytes_used{cluster=~"$cluster|"})
max by (pool_id) (ceph_pool_bytes_used{cluster=~"$cluster|"}) / (max by (pool_id) (ceph_pool_stored{cluster=~"$cluster|"}) > 0)
max by (pool_id) (ceph_pool_percent_used{cluster=~"$cluster|"})
max by (pool_id) (ceph_pool_max_avail{cluster=~"$cluster|"})
max by (pool_id) (deriv(ceph_pool_stored{cluster=~"$cluster|"}[7d])) * 86400
(max by (pool_id) (ceph_pool_max_avail{cluster=~"$cluster|"}) / on (pool_id) ((max by (pool_id) (deriv(ceph_pool_stored{cluster=~"$cluster|"}[7d])) * 86400) > 0)) < 3650

panels.title: Pool trends, filesystems and MDS (Ceph mgr metrics)
Pool stored over time (top $topk)
panels.description: Stacked client data per pool. Source: ceph_pool_stored.

targets.expr: topk($topk, max by (pool_id) (ceph_pool_stored{cluster=~"$cluster|"}) * on (pool_id) group_left (name) max by (pool_id, name) (ceph_pool_metadata{cluster=~"$cluster|"}))

panels.title: Pool growth per day (top $topk)
panels.description: Trend of stored over the preceding day, in bytes per day. Negative while a pool shrinks. Source: deriv of ceph_pool_stored.

targets.expr: topk($topk, (max by (pool_id) (deriv(ceph_pool_stored{cluster=~"$cluster|"}[1d])) * 86400) * on (pool_id) group_left (name) max by (pool_id, name) (ceph_pool_metadata{cluster=~"$cluster|"}))

panels.title: Filesystems and their pools
panels.description: From ceph_fs_metadata: pool ids (see the Pools table for names). Data stored sums the pools named cephfs.<fs>.data*, which is the naming the mgr creates; a pool named otherwise is missing from the sum. Source: ceph_fs_metadata, ceph_pool_stored.

targets.expr: max by (name, fs_id, data_pools, metadata_pool) (ceph_fs_metadata{cluster=~"$cluster|"})

sum by (name) (label_replace(max by (pool_id) (ceph_pool_stored{cluster=~"$cluster|"}) * on (pool_id) group_left (name) max by (pool_id, name) (ceph_pool_metadata{name=~"cephfs\\..+\\.data.*"}), "name", "$1", "name", "cephfs\\.([^.]+)\\..*"))

panels.title: MDS strays (deleted files waiting to be purged)
panels.description: Deleted inodes the MDS has not purged yet, per active MDS. They are still stored, so they sit in the CephFS residual below until the purge queue catches up; a count that keeps rising means it is behind. Source: ceph_mds_cache_num_strays.

targets.expr: max by (ceph_daemon) (ceph_mds_cache_num_strays) * on (ceph_daemon) group_left (fs_id) max by (ceph_daemon, fs_id) (ceph_mds_metadata{fs_id!="-1"}) * on (fs_id) group_left (name) max by (fs_id, name) (ceph_fs_metadata{cluster=~"$cluster|"})

panels.title: Raw bytes by owner (click to drill down)
panels.description: Raw bytes (replication and erasure coding included) per device class > pool > consumer > app > volume > live, snapshot or residual. Click a block to drill down, the breadcrumb goes back. Negative residuals show as 0. Source: storage-usage exporter (ceph_usage_*).

targets.expr: clamp_min(max by (source, device_class, pool, fs, consumer, app, volume, item, vmid, kind) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source!="rbd-k8s"}[1h]) or last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source="rbd-k8s"}[26h])), 0) * on (pool) group_left () max by (pool) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_pool_raw_ratio[1h]))
max by (vmid, name) (last_over_time(proxmox_vm_uptime[1d]))

panels.title: Raw bytes by consumer
panels.description: Raw bytes per device class > consumer > app; the inner ring is the device class. Hover for the path and size. Source: storage-usage exporter (ceph_usage_*).

targets.expr: sum by (device_class, consumer, app) (clamp_min(max by (source, device_class, pool, fs, consumer, app, volume, item, vmid, kind) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source!="rbd-k8s"}[1h]) or last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source="rbd-k8s"}[26h])), 0) * on (pool) group_left () max by (pool) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_pool_raw_ratio[1h])))
max by (vmid, name) (last_over_time(proxmox_vm_uptime[1d]))

panels.title: Growth per app (raw bytes per day, 7 d trend)
panels.description: The ten fastest growing apps: linear trend of their raw bytes over the previous 7 days, per day. Negative means shrinking; a consumer of (residual) is snapshot or pending-purge space of a pool. Source: storage-usage exporter (ceph_usage_*).

targets.expr: ((topk(10, sum by (consumer, app) (deriv(sum by (consumer, app, pool) (max by (source, device_class, pool, fs, consumer, app, volume, item, vmid, kind) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source!="rbd-k8s"}[1h]) or last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source="rbd-k8s"}[26h])))[7d:6h]) * on (pool) group_left () max by (pool) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_pool_raw_ratio[1h]))) * 86400)) * on (consumer, app) group_left (name) label_replace(label_replace((topk by (vmid) (1, last_over_time(proxmox_vm_uptime[1d])) * 0 + 1), "app", "$1", "vmid", "(.*)"), "consumer", "proxmox", "vmid", ".*")) or ((topk(10, sum by (consumer, app) (deriv(sum by (consumer, app, pool) (max by (source, device_class, pool, fs, consumer, app, volume, item, vmid, kind) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source!="rbd-k8s"}[1h]) or last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source="rbd-k8s"}[26h])))[7d:6h]) * on (pool) group_left () max by (pool) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_pool_raw_ratio[1h]))) * 86400)) unless on (consumer, app) label_replace(label_replace((topk by (vmid) (1, last_over_time(proxmox_vm_uptime[1d])) * 0 + 1), "app", "$1", "vmid", "(.*)"), "consumer", "proxmox", "vmid", ".*"))

panels.title: Per app
panels.description: One row per app (Kubernetes namespace, Swarm stack, Proxmox VM, S3 bucket owner or top directory). A directory several apps mount (a shared static PV) is the app, named after the directory, and Used by lists the namespaces. Live and snapshot are stored bytes; raw is stored times the pool's replication or erasure-coding ratio and includes the residuals. Source: storage-usage exporter (ceph_usage_*).

targets.expr: ((sum by (consumer, app, used_by) (max by (source, device_class, pool, fs, consumer, app, volume, item, vmid, kind, used_by) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{kind="live", device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source!="rbd-k8s"}[1h]) or last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{kind="live", device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source="rbd-k8s"}[26h])))) * on (consumer, app) group_left (name) label_replace(label_replace((topk by (vmid) (1, last_over_time(proxmox_vm_uptime[1d])) * 0 + 1), "app", "$1", "vmid", "(.*)"), "consumer", "proxmox", "vmid", ".*")) or ((sum by (consumer, app, used_by) (max by (source, device_class, pool, fs, consumer, app, volume, item, vmid, kind, used_by) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{kind="live", device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source!="rbd-k8s"}[1h]) or last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{kind="live", device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source="rbd-k8s"}[26h])))) unless on (consumer, app) label_replace(label_replace((topk by (vmid) (1, last_over_time(proxmox_vm_uptime[1d])) * 0 + 1), "app", "$1", "vmid", "(.*)"), "consumer", "proxmox", "vmid", ".*"))

((sum by (consumer, app, used_by) (max by (source, device_class, pool, fs, consumer, app, volume, item, vmid, kind, used_by) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{kind="snapshot", device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source!="rbd-k8s"}[1h]) or last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{kind="snapshot", device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source="rbd-k8s"}[26h])))) * on (consumer, app) group_left (name) label_replace(label_replace((topk by (vmid) (1, last_over_time(proxmox_vm_uptime[1d])) * 0 + 1), "app", "$1", "vmid", "(.*)"), "consumer", "proxmox", "vmid", ".*")) or ((sum by (consumer, app, used_by) (max by (source, device_class, pool, fs, consumer, app, volume, item, vmid, kind, used_by) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{kind="snapshot", device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source!="rbd-k8s"}[1h]) or last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{kind="snapshot", device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source="rbd-k8s"}[26h])))) unless on (consumer, app) label_replace(label_replace((topk by (vmid) (1, last_over_time(proxmox_vm_uptime[1d])) * 0 + 1), "app", "$1", "vmid", "(.*)"), "consumer", "proxmox", "vmid", ".*"))

((sum by (consumer, app, used_by) (clamp_min(max by (source, device_class, pool, fs, consumer, app, volume, item, vmid, kind, used_by) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source!="rbd-k8s"}[1h]) or last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source="rbd-k8s"}[26h])), 0) * on (pool) group_left () max by (pool) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_pool_raw_ratio[1h])))) * on (consumer, app) group_left (name) label_replace(label_replace((topk by (vmid) (1, last_over_time(proxmox_vm_uptime[1d])) * 0 + 1), "app", "$1", "vmid", "(.*)"), "consumer", "proxmox", "vmid", ".*")) or ((sum by (consumer, app, used_by) (clamp_min(max by (source, device_class, pool, fs, consumer, app, volume, item, vmid, kind, used_by) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source!="rbd-k8s"}[1h]) or last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source="rbd-k8s"}[26h])), 0) * on (pool) group_left () max by (pool) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_pool_raw_ratio[1h])))) unless on (consumer, app) label_replace(label_replace((topk by (vmid) (1, last_over_time(proxmox_vm_uptime[1d])) * 0 + 1), "app", "$1", "vmid", "(.*)"), "consumer", "proxmox", "vmid", ".*"))

panels.title: Top 20 apps by raw bytes
panels.description: The 20 apps with the most raw bytes (stored times replication or erasure-coding ratio). Source: storage-usage exporter (ceph_usage_*).

targets.expr: sort_desc(((topk(20, sum by (consumer, app) (clamp_min(max by (source, device_class, pool, fs, consumer, app, volume, item, vmid, kind) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source!="rbd-k8s"}[1h]) or last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source="rbd-k8s"}[26h])), 0) * on (pool) group_left () max by (pool) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_pool_raw_ratio[1h]))))) * on (consumer, app) group_left (name) label_replace(label_replace((topk by (vmid) (1, last_over_time(proxmox_vm_uptime[1d])) * 0 + 1), "app", "$1", "vmid", "(.*)"), "consumer", "proxmox", "vmid", ".*")) or ((topk(20, sum by (consumer, app) (clamp_min(max by (source, device_class, pool, fs, consumer, app, volume, item, vmid, kind) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source!="rbd-k8s"}[1h]) or last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source="rbd-k8s"}[26h])), 0) * on (pool) group_left () max by (pool) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_pool_raw_ratio[1h]))))) unless on (consumer, app) label_replace(label_replace((topk by (vmid) (1, last_over_time(proxmox_vm_uptime[1d])) * 0 + 1), "app", "$1", "vmid", "(.*)"), "consumer", "proxmox", "vmid", ".*")))

panels.title: Per volume
panels.description: One row per measured volume, path, image or bucket. Live and snapshot are stored bytes (CephFS snapshots are a lower bound); raw includes replication or erasure coding. Source: storage-usage exporter (ceph_usage_*).

targets.expr: ((sum by (consumer, app, used_by, volume, fs, pool, item) (max by (source, device_class, pool, fs, consumer, app, volume, item, vmid, kind, used_by) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{kind="live", device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source!="rbd-k8s"}[1h]) or last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{kind="live", device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source="rbd-k8s"}[26h])))) * on (consumer, app) group_left (name) label_replace(label_replace((topk by (vmid) (1, last_over_time(proxmox_vm_uptime[1d])) * 0 + 1), "app", "$1", "vmid", "(.*)"), "consumer", "proxmox", "vmid", ".*")) or ((sum by (consumer, app, used_by, volume, fs, pool, item) (max by (source, device_class, pool, fs, consumer, app, volume, item, vmid, kind, used_by) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{kind="live", device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source!="rbd-k8s"}[1h]) or last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{kind="live", device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source="rbd-k8s"}[26h])))) unless on (consumer, app) label_replace(label_replace((topk by (vmid) (1, last_over_time(proxmox_vm_uptime[1d])) * 0 + 1), "app", "$1", "vmid", "(.*)"), "consumer", "proxmox", "vmid", ".*"))

((sum by (consumer, app, used_by, volume, fs, pool, item) (max by (source, device_class, pool, fs, consumer, app, volume, item, vmid, kind, used_by) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{kind="snapshot", device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source!="rbd-k8s"}[1h]) or last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{kind="snapshot", device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source="rbd-k8s"}[26h])))) * on (consumer, app) group_left (name) label_replace(label_replace((topk by (vmid) (1, last_over_time(proxmox_vm_uptime[1d])) * 0 + 1), "app", "$1", "vmid", "(.*)"), "consumer", "proxmox", "vmid", ".*")) or ((sum by (consumer, app, used_by, volume, fs, pool, item) (max by (source, device_class, pool, fs, consumer, app, volume, item, vmid, kind, used_by) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{kind="snapshot", device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source!="rbd-k8s"}[1h]) or last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{kind="snapshot", device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source="rbd-k8s"}[26h])))) unless on (consumer, app) label_replace(label_replace((topk by (vmid) (1, last_over_time(proxmox_vm_uptime[1d])) * 0 + 1), "app", "$1", "vmid", "(.*)"), "consumer", "proxmox", "vmid", ".*"))

((sum by (consumer, app, used_by, volume, fs, pool, item) (clamp_min(max by (source, device_class, pool, fs, consumer, app, volume, item, vmid, kind, used_by) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source!="rbd-k8s"}[1h]) or last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source="rbd-k8s"}[26h])), 0) * on (pool) group_left () max by (pool) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_pool_raw_ratio[1h])))) * on (consumer, app) group_left (name) label_replace(label_replace((topk by (vmid) (1, last_over_time(proxmox_vm_uptime[1d])) * 0 + 1), "app", "$1", "vmid", "(.*)"), "consumer", "proxmox", "vmid", ".*")) or ((sum by (consumer, app, used_by, volume, fs, pool, item) (clamp_min(max by (source, device_class, pool, fs, consumer, app, volume, item, vmid, kind, used_by) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source!="rbd-k8s"}[1h]) or last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer", source="rbd-k8s"}[26h])), 0) * on (pool) group_left () max by (pool) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_pool_raw_ratio[1h])))) unless on (consumer, app) label_replace(label_replace((topk by (vmid) (1, last_over_time(proxmox_vm_uptime[1d])) * 0 + 1), "app", "$1", "vmid", "(.*)"), "consumer", "proxmox", "vmid", ".*"))

panels.title: Dynamic PVC fill level
panels.description: Fill level of the dynamic (provisioned) PVCs a pod has mounted, from the kubelet's volume stats (k8s.volume.capacity and k8s.volume.available, via the cluster collector). A PVC no pod mounts has no stats. Static PVs are left out by joining ceph_usage_pv_info{static="false"}, which the exporter emits from the PersistentVolume list, so no PVC name list is kept here. The collector's k8s.namespace.name and k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name are moved to app and volume to match.

targets.expr: (((label_move(label_move(max by ("k8s.namespace.name", "k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name") (last_over_time(k8s.volume.capacity{"k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name"!=""}[15m])), "k8s.namespace.name", "app"), "k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name", "volume")) - (label_move(label_move(max by ("k8s.namespace.name", "k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name") (last_over_time(k8s.volume.available{"k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name"!=""}[15m])), "k8s.namespace.name", "app"), "k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name", "volume"))) / (label_move(label_move(max by ("k8s.namespace.name", "k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name") (last_over_time(k8s.volume.capacity{"k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name"!=""}[15m])), "k8s.namespace.name", "app"), "k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name", "volume"))) * on (app, volume) group_left (storage_class) max by (app, volume, storage_class) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_pv_info{static="false"}[1h]))

((label_move(label_move(max by ("k8s.namespace.name", "k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name") (last_over_time(k8s.volume.capacity{"k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name"!=""}[15m])), "k8s.namespace.name", "app"), "k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name", "volume")) - (label_move(label_move(max by ("k8s.namespace.name", "k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name") (last_over_time(k8s.volume.available{"k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name"!=""}[15m])), "k8s.namespace.name", "app"), "k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name", "volume"))) * on (app, volume) group_left (storage_class) max by (app, volume, storage_class) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_pv_info{static="false"}[1h]))

(label_move(label_move(max by ("k8s.namespace.name", "k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name") (last_over_time(k8s.volume.capacity{"k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name"!=""}[15m])), "k8s.namespace.name", "app"), "k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name", "volume")) * on (app, volume) group_left (storage_class) max by (app, volume, storage_class) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_pv_info{static="false"}[1h]))

panels.title: CephFS snapshot directories
panels.description: Directories with CephFS snapshots. Pinned bytes are a lower bound: the oldest snapshot's tree minus its live bytes, summed per walked leaf; CephFS has no exclusive snapshot size. A large newest age shows a snapshot schedule that stopped. Source: storage-usage exporter (ceph_usage_*).

targets.expr: max by (fs, item, consumer, app, used_by) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_snapshots{source="cephfs", consumer=~"$consumer"}[1h]))
time() - max by (fs, item, consumer, app, used_by) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_snapshot_oldest_timestamp_seconds{source="cephfs", consumer=~"$consumer"}[1h]))
time() - max by (fs, item, consumer, app, used_by) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_snapshot_newest_timestamp_seconds{source="cephfs", consumer=~"$consumer"}[1h]))
max by (fs, item, consumer, app, used_by) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_snapshot_pinned_min_bytes{source="cephfs", consumer=~"$consumer"}[1h]))

panels.title: RBD snapshots
panels.description: RBD images that have snapshots, Proxmox VM disks and Kubernetes volumes in one table: count and age of the oldest and newest snapshot. Proxmox: snapshot-only bytes are exact. Kubernetes volumes (app is the namespace, volume the PVC): the snapshots are Velero's and their space is in the pool residual, so per-volume bytes are not measured. Source: storage-usage exporter (ceph_usage_*), VM names from proxmox_vm_uptime.

targets.expr: ((max by (source, consumer, app, volume, item, pool, vmid) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_snapshots{source="rbd-k8s", consumer=~"$consumer"}[26h]) or last_over_time(ceph_usage_snapshots{source="rbd-proxmox", consumer=~"$consumer"}[1h]))) * on (consumer, app) group_left (name) label_replace(label_replace((topk by (vmid) (1, last_over_time(proxmox_vm_uptime[1d])) * 0 + 1), "app", "$1", "vmid", "(.*)"), "consumer", "proxmox", "vmid", ".*")) or ((max by (source, consumer, app, volume, item, pool, vmid) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_snapshots{source="rbd-k8s", consumer=~"$consumer"}[26h]) or last_over_time(ceph_usage_snapshots{source="rbd-proxmox", consumer=~"$consumer"}[1h]))) unless on (consumer, app) label_replace(label_replace((topk by (vmid) (1, last_over_time(proxmox_vm_uptime[1d])) * 0 + 1), "app", "$1", "vmid", "(.*)"), "consumer", "proxmox", "vmid", ".*"))

((time() - max by (source, consumer, app, volume, item, pool, vmid) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_snapshot_oldest_timestamp_seconds{source="rbd-k8s", consumer=~"$consumer"}[26h]) or last_over_time(ceph_usage_snapshot_oldest_timestamp_seconds{source="rbd-proxmox", consumer=~"$consumer"}[1h]))) * on (consumer, app) group_left (name) label_replace(label_replace((topk by (vmid) (1, last_over_time(proxmox_vm_uptime[1d])) * 0 + 1), "app", "$1", "vmid", "(.*)"), "consumer", "proxmox", "vmid", ".*")) or ((time() - max by (source, consumer, app, volume, item, pool, vmid) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_snapshot_oldest_timestamp_seconds{source="rbd-k8s", consumer=~"$consumer"}[26h]) or last_over_time(ceph_usage_snapshot_oldest_timestamp_seconds{source="rbd-proxmox", consumer=~"$consumer"}[1h]))) unless on (consumer, app) label_replace(label_replace((topk by (vmid) (1, last_over_time(proxmox_vm_uptime[1d])) * 0 + 1), "app", "$1", "vmid", "(.*)"), "consumer", "proxmox", "vmid", ".*"))

((time() - max by (source, consumer, app, volume, item, pool, vmid) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_snapshot_newest_timestamp_seconds{source="rbd-k8s", consumer=~"$consumer"}[26h]) or last_over_time(ceph_usage_snapshot_newest_timestamp_seconds{source="rbd-proxmox", consumer=~"$consumer"}[1h]))) * on (consumer, app) group_left (name) label_replace(label_replace((topk by (vmid) (1, last_over_time(proxmox_vm_uptime[1d])) * 0 + 1), "app", "$1", "vmid", "(.*)"), "consumer", "proxmox", "vmid", ".*")) or ((time() - max by (source, consumer, app, volume, item, pool, vmid) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_snapshot_newest_timestamp_seconds{source="rbd-k8s", consumer=~"$consumer"}[26h]) or last_over_time(ceph_usage_snapshot_newest_timestamp_seconds{source="rbd-proxmox", consumer=~"$consumer"}[1h]))) unless on (consumer, app) label_replace(label_replace((topk by (vmid) (1, last_over_time(proxmox_vm_uptime[1d])) * 0 + 1), "app", "$1", "vmid", "(.*)"), "consumer", "proxmox", "vmid", ".*"))

((max by (source, consumer, app, volume, item, pool, vmid) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{source="rbd-proxmox", kind="snapshot", consumer=~"$consumer"}[1h]))) * on (consumer, app) group_left (name) label_replace(label_replace((topk by (vmid) (1, last_over_time(proxmox_vm_uptime[1d])) * 0 + 1), "app", "$1", "vmid", "(.*)"), "consumer", "proxmox", "vmid", ".*")) or ((max by (source, consumer, app, volume, item, pool, vmid) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{source="rbd-proxmox", kind="snapshot", consumer=~"$consumer"}[1h]))) unless on (consumer, app) label_replace(label_replace((topk by (vmid) (1, last_over_time(proxmox_vm_uptime[1d])) * 0 + 1), "app", "$1", "vmid", "(.*)"), "consumer", "proxmox", "vmid", ".*"))

panels.title: S3 buckets
panels.description: Bucket sizes come only from the storage-usage exporter (RGW admin API, size_actual): the Ceph mgr's ceph_rgw_* metrics are request counters and latencies, not usage. Growth is the linear trend over the previous 7 days, per day. Source: ceph_usage_bytes and ceph_usage_rgw_bucket_objects, refreshed hourly.

targets.expr: max by (app, volume) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{source="rgw", kind="live", device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer"}[2h]))
max by (app, volume) (label_replace(last_over_time(ceph_usage_rgw_bucket_objects[2h]), "volume", "$1", "bucket", "(.*)"))
deriv(max by (app, volume) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{source="rgw", kind="live", device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer"}[2h]))[7d:6h]) * 86400

panels.title: Bucket size over time (top $topk)
panels.description: Bucket sizes come only from the storage-usage exporter (RGW admin API, size_actual): the Ceph mgr's ceph_rgw_* metrics are request counters and latencies, not usage. Stored bytes of the largest buckets, from ceph_usage_bytes.

targets.expr: topk($topk, max by (volume) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{source="rgw", kind="live", device_class=~"$device_class", consumer=~"$consumer"}[2h])))

panels.title: Residual per pool
panels.description: Stored bytes of a pool that no leaf accounts for. Signed: positive is snapshots and pending purge (CephFS, RBD) or unattributed data (RGW); negative means the leaves add up to more than the pool stores (for example shared or deduplicated extents). The app column says which. Source: storage-usage exporter (ceph_usage_*).

targets.expr: max by (pool, device_class, app, source) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{kind="residual", source!="rbd-k8s", device_class=~"$device_class"}[1h]) or last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{kind="residual", source="rbd-k8s", device_class=~"$device_class"}[26h]))

max by (pool, device_class, app, source) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{kind="residual", source!="rbd-k8s", device_class=~"$device_class"}[1h]) or last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{kind="residual", source="rbd-k8s", device_class=~"$device_class"}[26h])) * 0 + on (pool, device_class) group_left () max by (pool, device_class) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_pool_stored_bytes[1h]))

max by (pool, device_class, app, source) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{kind="residual", source!="rbd-k8s", device_class=~"$device_class"}[1h]) or last_over_time(ceph_usage_bytes{kind="residual", source="rbd-k8s", device_class=~"$device_class"}[26h])) / on (pool, device_class) group_left () max by (pool, device_class) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_pool_stored_bytes[1h]))

panels.title: Exporter tasks
panels.description: State of the exporter's collection tasks. The numbers above are as old as the last success; the cluster-wide tasks run every 10 to 60 minutes, the Kubernetes RBD scan daily. Partial: the last run returned only part of its data (the RBD scan hit its time budget, or a CephFS filesystem failed); what it did measure is shown, the rest is marked unmeasured or stale, and Last run ok is failed. Item errors: images or filesystems skipped on an error, summed per task; ceph_usage_task_item_errors has the filesystem. Source: the task status metrics of the exporter.

targets.expr: time() - max by (task) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_task_last_success_timestamp_seconds[3d]))
max by (task) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_task_last_duration_seconds[3d]))
max by (task) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_task_last_run_ok[3d]))
sum by (task) (max by (task, fs) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_task_item_errors[3d])))
max by (task) (last_over_time(ceph_usage_task_partial[3d]))
